Exercise 1: Rounding
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```

Exercise 2: Argument Order
```{r}
# specifying arguments in order
print(rep(5, 7))

#specifying arguments by their name
print(rep(times = 7, x = 5))
```

Exercise 3: Assigning values to variables
I think the value would be 5. 

Exercise 4: Character, logical and numerical variables
```{r}
#result for character
x <- "My name is Joanne"
print(class(x))

#result for logical
y <- TRUE
print(class(y))

#result for numerical
z <- 4.6
print(class(z))
```

Exercise 5: Using variables of different types
```{r}
#cell CX1
name_1 <- "CX1"
treated_1 <- TRUE
cells_before_1 <- 5415
cells_after_1 <- 1432

#cell CX2 
name_2 <- "CX2"
treated_2 <- FALSE
cells_before_2 <- 8123
cells_after_2 <- 7543

print(name_1)

```
